Question: Dear Molana Sb, Assalawalekum, what asked the islam when husband & wife create the oral sex relationship, our some friend asking me the oral sex permitted in relation of husband & wife but i think is wrong . Please explain the matter this is very important some our muslim bhai create the above relations regularly.please given the answer this type of relations haram or halal...Islaah Karain... Answer ID: 10311 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 187/165=B/1429) Oral sex is not good, one must avoid it; it is shamelessness and obscenity. It is culture of the Jews and the Christians. We should shun from such inhuman ways, it is unnatural and animalistic behaviour. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
